inputs.text:
They expect us to believe this is just an accidental slip-up or routine incompetence, but that is nothing more than the official cover story. The hidden elites and institutions are orchestrating a systemic operation, and the court documents expose the true, concealed agenda behind the machinery of the state. 

Lawyers for ICE provided false information to justify arresting and detaining thousands of people who had attended immigration courts. They tried to use an agency memo from May of last year to justify the arrests, yet federal prosecutors now admit that this very memo gave no authorization for the arrests at all. 

This was a calculated, systemic operation to target people seeking to gain legal status as they leave immigration courts. It is all part of their coordinated manipulation, perfectly revealing how the system operates under a false narrative while carrying out its real, hidden motives.
